metadata.title: Modern Country Portrait with Distressed Gold Lettering

retrievalProfile.description: A centered male portrait against a dark textured backdrop featuring heavy-impasto gold distressed lettering and a thin gold border frame.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man in a white t-shirt and baseball cap, seated against a dark, moody teal curtain. The composition is framed by a thin gold line, with large, expressive, gold-textured brush-script typography occupying the upper left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: The bright white of the t-shirt acts as the primary light source and visual anchor against the dark background.
The gold color of the typography is echoed in the thin border and the subject's jewelry.
The rough, painterly texture of the text contrasts with the smooth fabric of the clothing and the soft focus of the background.
coreInvariants: Dark teal or navy textured fabric background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned slightly right of center, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white t-shirt in the center-right and the large gold title in the upper-left create a diagonal balance.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large gold title, moves down to the subject's face, and follows the white shirt down to the hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left and far right areas provide breathing room for the heavy typography and framing.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark teal/navy background providing depth and mood.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white t-shirt creating a central focal point.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold used for typography, framing, and jewelry.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-value background with high-value subject and high-saturation gold accents.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to deep blues, whites, and golds

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Expressive, slanted brush script with irregular baselines.
letterConstructionRules: Heavy impasto texture with visible brush strokes
Inconsistent stroke widths with dry-brush effects
Tall, condensed proportions for the main title
Jagged, distressed edges mimicking thick paint on canvas
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are elongated and tapered
Internal counters are small and often partially filled by texture
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, expressive brush script paired with a smaller, widely-spaced weathered serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, textured brush feel
Suitable for the secondary artist name text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a white t-shirt and black baseball cap, sitting against a dark teal draped fabric background with moody lighting. Include a thin gold rectangular border near the edges of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, hand-painted gold metallic lettering in the upper left corner with a thick, distressed impasto texture. Add the artist name in a smaller, gold, weathered serif font below it with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the gold text heavily textured like thick paint?
Is there a thin gold border framing the entire image?
Is the background a dark, moody teal fabric?
Is the subject wearing a plain white t-shirt?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the hat
Exact facial features of the individual

avoid: Flat yellow colors instead of gold

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold border is perfectly rectangular and thin.
Check that the gold texture in the text has highlights and shadows for a 3D effect.
Verify the white t-shirt is the brightest element in the photograph.
Confirm the typography does not obscure the subject's face.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Dark Textured Backdrop + Thin Gold Frame + Impasto Gold Brush Lettering
